pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Highly irregular dark brown-to-black regions with diffuse, low-contrast edge gradients. Patches on the upper flank exhibit star-like or jagged perimeters with significant pixel-level serration. Relative spatial area of patches decreases significantly toward the lower flank and hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light grey-to-tan interstitial network with low-contrast boundaries. Junction nodes are frequent and irregular. Pathway thickness is non-uniform, frequently narrowed by the serrated protrusions of the adjacent dark patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Jagged 1D silhouette visible on the upper dorsal line with irregular frequency and moderate amplitude against the blurred background, though partially occluded by foreground vegetation.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A pronounced area of textural disruption and de-pigmentation is visible on the mid-upper flank, characterized by a light tan-to-white coloration that interrupts the primary dark patch sequence.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, irregular de-pigmented patch or lesion located on the central-right flank, exhibiting a distinct color and texture profile from the surrounding corridor network.
other_distinctive_markers: Primary patches exhibit an exceptionally high degree of edge diffusion and star-burst geometry across the entire visible torso, creating high-frequency transitions into the corridor network.
